confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Spanish Mediterranean resort pricing for July peak season. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because July peak rates vary widely by date and property. FX caveat: the 0.6955 rate was reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page as at 4.00 pm 15 Oct 2026. I did not read that page directly, and I could not confirm a 16 Oct 2026 RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benidorm is a large Costa Blanca beach resort. Pricing is benchmarked against other Spanish Mediterranean resort towns with heavy July tourism, such as Calpe, Salou and Torremolinos, and converted from EUR at general-knowledge rates. No web search was used for city-price anchors.
